title:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, clear the compose cooldown when a compose never ran.

ANCHO
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, clear the compose cooldown when a compose never ran.

ANCHOR — this exact line already exists in the file, match it verbatim, do not paraphrase it:
    if (isNonAttemptComposeResult(cb)) {

Immediately inside that branch, add one statement that removes this gap's entry from the in-memory cooldown map, so the gap becomes eligible for the auto-pick candidate set again instead of waiting out the full cooldown. The map is the module-level `gapComposeLastAttemptAt` (a Map<string, number> declared near the top of the same file, beside `const GAP_COMPOSE_COOLDOWN_MS`). Delete the entry keyed by the gap's id. Keep the existing console.log in that branch exactly as it is, and add a short comment saying that a compose that never ran must not cost the gap its cooldown.

Do not touch the `else` branch. Do not change GAP_COMPOSE_COOLDOWN_MS. Do not change any other file.

WARNING FROM THE PREVIOUS ATTEMPT: a prior draft failed because it invented old-strings that are not in the file — it guessed `console.log("gap credit not bumped");` and `console.log("gap credit bumped, category calibration will now include", g.category);`. Neither exists. The only real log line in that branch is a single long string concatenation beginning `console.log("[gap-to-feature] non-attempt (failure_kind=" + String(cb.failure_kind ?? "-")`. Anchor on the `if (isNonAttemptComposeResult(cb)) {` line instead; it is short, exact and unique.

WHY: the cooldown is stamped at pick-start by `if (!pointer.gap_id && gap.id) gapComposeLastAttemptAt.set(String(gap.id), Date.now());` and read by the eligibility filter `nowMs - (gapComposeLastAttemptAt.get(String(g.id ?? "")) ?? 0) >= GAP_COMPOSE_COOLDOWN_MS`. Because the stamp happens before feature_compose runs and is never cleared on a capacity refusal, a compose that never ran costs its gap a full five minutes of exclusion. The same file already states the governing principle in the comment above isNonAttemptComposeResult: "A compose that never RAN is not a compose that FAILED." That principle was applied to failed_attempts and to category calibration but never to the cooldown. This change extends it to selection.

Also add a test that asserts both directions: after a non-attempt result the gap is immediately re-eligible, and after a genuine non-landing compose the gap is still cooled for the full interval.
